## 🎯 Why Sponsor DevWrapped 2025?

**DevWrapped 2025** transforms boring GitHub stats into cinematic, AI-powered year-in-review experiences. It's completely **free**, **open source**, and **privacy-first** - but maintaining and improving it takes time and resources.

### 🌟 **What Your Sponsorship Enables:**

- 🤖 **AI Innovation**: Advanced Gemini AI features and better insights
- 🚀 **Infrastructure**: Reliable hosting and fast performance
- 📱 **Mobile Excellence**: Continued mobile optimization and new features
- 🔒 **Privacy & Security**: Maintaining our zero-data-retention promise
- 🆕 **New Features**: Export formats, visualizations, and analysis types
- 🐛 **Quality Assurance**: Bug fixes, testing, and maintenance
- 📚 **Documentation**: Comprehensive guides and tutorials
